title: Las Cruces, NM — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Las Cruces, NM: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Las Cruces is a city in NM with a population of 104,000. Southern New Mexico city with New Mexico State University and the Organ Mountains. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.7.
